title: Normalized composition isomorphism for scheme derived direct images
statement: Let $X,Y,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with their derived categories of sheaves of modules [def-pc-derived-category], and let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$. Write $Rf_*$, $Rg_*$ and $R(g\circ f)_*$ for their derived direct images [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. The normalized direct-image composition isomorphism $c(f,g):Rg_*\circ Rf_*\xrightarrow{\sim}R(g\circ f)_*$ is the comparison selected together with its right-derived-unit equation from [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition], specialized to the underlying ringed-space morphisms. Explicitly, for each object $K$ of the homotopy category of complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, its inverse satisfies $\eta_{g\circ f,K};c(f,g)^{-1}_{QK}=\eta_{g,f_*^hK};Rg_*(\eta_{f,K})$, where $Q$ is localization to the derived category, $f_*^h$ is termwise direct image on the homotopy category, $\eta_t$ is the right-derived unit of $t_*$, and semicolons denote composition from left to right. This unit equation determines the comparison uniquely. No quasi-compactness, separatedness, boundedness, or quasi-coherence assumption is imposed.

def schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage g ≅
      schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ≫ g)
